item.title: When Fully Patched Means Vulnerable: The BlackX UEFI Bootkit Fallout
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Even fully patched Windows machines fell victim to the BlackX UEFI bootkit. Why are critical security mitigations buried in Microsoft documentation?
[SPLIT] ⚡ Organizations that installed all official Microsoft patches remained vulnerable because final protection required manual revocation of legacy certificates. [SPLIT] ⚡ Microsoft's patch deployment strategy deliberately avoids automatic revocation to prevent rendering millions of unready enterprise devices unbootable. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/when-fully-patched-means-vulnerable-the-blackx-uefi-bootkit-fallout-737568.html

item.title: Leonardo DRS Joins Army’s Historic Directed Energy Push
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The US Army is moving directed energy weapons from prototypes to the front lines. Now, Leonardo DRS is stepping in to solve the brutal engineering hurdles of fielding mobile lasers in combat.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Leonardo DRS will supply critical rugged integration, power, and thermal management expertise for the LOCUST X3 laser weapon systems. [SPLIT] ⚡ The initiative addresses the urgent operational demand for cost-effective, non-kinetic layered defenses against proliferating battlefield drones. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/leonardo-drs-joins-army-s-historic-directed-energy-push-659034.html
